summary: Implementation plan for Dhaka WasteTrack — an interactive municipal waste management and public accountability dashboard prototype for Team MacroMind (CPD Climate Week 2026). Covers 11 functional navigation modules, a dual-mode interactive SVG schematic and Dhaka map with route simulation, interactive WtE 4-gate viability checklist, chain-of-custody batch tracking, ward/contractor accountability tables, citizen complaint simulation, and a Guided Walkthrough Presentation Mode for competition judges.
